answer: Proof-of-space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to commit uncompressible disk storage. To curb an identity replication spiral, an attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical drive capacity per registration. Cryptographic challenges serve as an audit lantern, granting each verified agent a jade credential through strict read latency bounds. A key limitation is that adversaries with access to surplus enterprise storage can cheaply forge multiple identities.
